default.label: Balanced
default.description: Balances structural similarity and supporting evidence. Weights are provisional, not statistically calibrated.

reactant_category.label: Closest reactant category
reactant_category.description: Prioritizes matching reacting-center element, substitution, hydrogen state, and attached aliphatic/aryl classes.

functional_group_tolerance.label: Evidence for your functional groups
functional_group_tolerance.description: Prioritizes direct precedent evidence for unchanged query functional groups.

evidence.label: Strongest supporting evidence
evidence.description: Prioritizes independent support, reaction breadth, and dataset diversity.

yield.label: Historical yield
yield.description: Prioritizes similarity-weighted precedent outcomes while retaining chemistry and compatibility gates.

procedure_completeness.label: Procedure completeness
procedure_completeness.description: Prioritizes resolved condition identities and assigned operating stages.

closest_chemistry.label: Closest chemistry
closest_chemistry.description: Prioritizes structural and reacting-center similarity within each evidence level.
